SELECT COUNT(*) AS virtual_school_count
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS st
ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.CDSCode
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 500;

SELECT 
  MAX(frp."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM 
  schools s
  INNER JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
  INNER JOIN frpm frp ON s.CDSCode = frp.CDSCode
WHERE 
  CAST(sc.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sc.NumTstTakr > 0.3;
